status: curated primary-source metadata for contextual ADR load anchors
scope: These are published system-level examples, not NBCP device assumptions or a statistical distribution.
Temperatures, architectures, refrigerants, and thermal interfaces differ, so the loads must not be transferred as performance predictions.
Only steady or experimentally inferred parasitic loads are used as plot anchors; transient regeneration and ramp losses remain unmodelled.

anchors.system: compact cryogen-free four-stage cADR sample stage
anchors.refrigerant: CPA in the two lowest stages
anchors.citation: P. Schuessler et al., Review of Scientific Instruments 97, 025214 (2026)
anchors.evidence_note: Single-shot sample stage warmed from 20 to 25 mK over 10 h; the inferred base parasitic load was reported to be of order 0.2 microWatt.

anchors.citation: NASA GSFC LAMBDA, MSAM/Tophat Adiabatic Demagnetization Refrigerator
anchors.evidence_note: The page reports 0.97 microWatt quiescent load, 134 mJ capacity and 138 ks hold at 100 mK. The heat-load identity gives 133.86 mJ.

anchors.citation: J. Bartlett, G. Hardy and I. D. Hepburn, Cryogenics 72, 111-121 (2015)
anchors.evidence_note: The article reports a 3 min hold at 0.2 K with 13.14 microWatt parasitics.
